name: Nile
overview: The Nile, often called 'The River' or 'Sihor' in Scripture, is depicted as a vital source of life and sustenance for Egypt, yet it is also subject to God's sovereign judgment. Isaiah prophesies the drying up and devastation of the Nile and its tributaries, symbolizing God's power to bring desolation upon the land, as the waters fail and the fishers and workers dependent on the river mourn. This imagery underscores God's authority over creation and His ability to humble nations by controlling even their most essential resources.
